t: This is the Rolling Bridge, a small footbridge over the water at Paddington Basin that is really a kinetic sculpture. Completed in 2004, it was part of the Grand Union Canal office and retail development here. It's a curling moveable bridge: instead of lifting, it rolls up on itself. It's scheduled to open every Wednesday and Friday at noon, and every Saturday at 2 pm. Thomas Heatherwick, the English designer behind Heatherwick Studio, designed it.
